# Test Fixtures (`tests/fixtures/`)

> **NOTICE**: All files in this directory are small, isolated **SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURES** designed strictly for automated unit and contract validation testing.
>
> They do NOT represent real government data, official disaster statistics, or actual Chamoli demographic records.

---

## Purpose
* Verify schema validation, null checks, range checks, and duplicate detection.
* Verify spatial geometry validation, CRS parsing, and bounding box intersection checks.
* Verify failure handling (malformed files, missing columns, corrupt geometries) and blocking of curated promotion.
